title: fix(scripts): read the last JSON document on pnpm pack --json stdout
body:
Fixes #22752

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs` `packOne` parsed the WHOLE stdout of `pnpm pack --json --pack-destination DEST`. Since `@objectstack/spec` declared `prepare: pnpm gen:migration-registry`, pnpm prints that lifecycle banner and the generator's output above the JSON document. The parse therefore threw on every pack of the full population, so the scaffold smoke (`os-create-smoke.yml`) and the release smoke (`scripts/publish-smoke.sh`) both died at their first pack step.

The parse moves into an exported pure helper, `parsePackStdout(stdout, name)`, and `packOne` now calls it. The helper returns the LAST JSON document on stdout: it walks the `{` offsets from the end and takes the first suffix that `JSON.parse` accepts whole. These stay unchanged: the `filename` check, the set of packages packed, the overrides map, `assertPinSetTotal`, and everything `publish-smoke.sh` / `create-scaffold-smoke.sh` judge. The spec's `prepare` is untouched. The diff is one file, +120 / -26.

## Measurements (pnpm 10.31.0, worktree at `bf515e724`)

**1. The banner precedes the document (confirmed).** Here is the stdout head of `pnpm pack --json --pack-destination D` in `packages/spec`, verbatim except the worktree path, written WT:

```text

> @objectstack/spec@17.7.0 prepare WT/packages/spec
> pnpm gen:migration-registry


> @objectstack/spec@17.7.0 gen:migration-registry WT/packages/spec
> tsx scripts/build-migration-registry.ts

build-migration-registry --self-test: ok
✓ src/migrations/registry.ts is current (420 semantic, 258 retired-key, 222 retired-def)
{
  "name": "@objectstack/spec",
  "version": "17.7.0",
```

- The pack exits 0 with empty stderr and 974 stdout lines. The document starts on line 11.
- Parsing that stdout whole throws `Unexpected token` at the first banner character, which is the base behaviour.
- `parsePackStdout` on the same bytes returns the tarball filename.

**2. The document is always last.**

- pnpm 10.31.0's own pack handler (`dist/pnpm.cjs`) runs `prepack` and `prepare` before the tarball and `postpack` right after it. All three run inside the pack API with inherited stdio. The CLI writes the returned JSON string only after the handler returns, and its update notifier runs for `install`/`add` only.
- I measured this on a throwaway package that declares all three hooks. Every banner and echo line (PREPACK, PREPARE, POSTPACK) lands above the document, and nothing lands after it.
- Census of all 81 workspace members: no `prepack` or `postpack` anywhere. `prepare` appears only on `@objectstack/spec` (publishable) and on the private root. `prepublishOnly` appears on `@objectstack/console`, and pack does not run it.
- A second measurement shaped the selector. A lifecycle script whose last write has no newline glues onto the document's opening brace. For example, `printf "{ not json"` as `postpack` leaves a line reading `{ not json{`. A line-start selector would refuse that valid pack, and the per-brace scan reads it.

**3. No flag keeps lifecycle output off stdout.**

- I tried `--silent`, `--reporter=silent`, `--loglevel=error`, `--loglevel=silent`, `--reporter=ndjson` and `--reporter=append-only`, each before and after `pack`. In every case the banner and the script output stay on stdout. Lifecycle stdio is inherited, so no reporter setting reaches it.
- pnpm 10.31.0's pack refuses `--ignore-scripts` outright: `ERROR Unknown option: 'ignore-scripts'`, exit 1.
- The env spelling `npm_config_ignore_scripts=true` is accepted, but it skips `prepare`, which `gen:migration-registry` needs (its output, `src/migrations/registry.ts`, is gitignored). It was not measured equal, so it is not used.

## Why the last document rather than the document carrying `filename`

pnpm writes its document strictly last (measurement 2), so output after it is a shape nobody has observed. The last-document selector keeps that case loud: no suffix parses, and the named error prints stdout. A search keyed on `filename` would skip such output silently. The `filename` check still runs on the selected document.

## Self-test

The battery `publish-smoke-pack self-test` grows from 4 to 10 cases, and its pin is raised to 10.

| # | case | expected |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | banner (the measured spec head), then the document | filename read |
| 6 | the document alone (the shape before `prepare` existed) | read |
| 7 | script output glued to the opening brace | read |
| 8 | output AFTER the document | throws, names the package, carries stdout |
| 9 | stdout with no JSON document | throws, names the package, carries stdout |
| 10 | `packOne` itself against a fake `pnpm` | the fake's document is read |

The fake `pnpm` in case 10 is a `#!/bin/sh` script in a `mkdtemp` dir, prepended to PATH. It prints the banner, then a document whose `filename` echoes its `--pack-destination` argument, so the filename proves that the fake answered, with packOne's argv.

`selfTest()` is now async, because case 10 awaits `packOne`. The handshake keeps its kind: the dispatch awaits the self-test and still refuses anything but `SELF_TEST_VERDICT`.

**How case 10 fits the header's "pure fixtures, no workspace, no network".** It spawns one process: a fake pnpm that the self-test writes into an OS temp dir and removes in a `finally`, where PATH is restored too. It reads no workspace, no network and no tracked file, and it never runs the real pnpm. The `no-path-population` declaration therefore still holds. The header and the marker's reason now say "fixtures plus one fake pnpm in a temp dir" instead of "in-memory fixtures".

## Ablation (fix committed first, at `34fff6b49`)

The mutation makes the helper parse stdout whole:

```text
node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file REPO/scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs \
  --anchor 'parsed = JSON.parse(stdout.slice(at));' --replacement 'parsed = JSON.parse(stdout);' \
  -- node REPO/scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs --self-test

ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 8ef4ed21a713 -> a4e5fc75a5b6
  FAIL — a lifecycle banner above the document is skipped
  FAIL — script output glued to the opening brace is skipped
  FAIL — packOne reads the document past a fake pnpm that prints a banner first
SELF-TEST FAILED
ablation-replace: command exited 1
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (8ef4ed21a713) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The other seven cases stay ok under the mutation. The re-run after the restore prints `SELF-TEST PASSED (10 cases)`.

## Real pnpm

- `node scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs D` is the scaffold smoke's step 1. I ran it with real pnpm 10.31.0 over the full population, under the shared verify lock. It printed `Packing 69 publishable package(s)`, then `packed 69/69`, then `Wrote 69 override(s)`, with `VERDICT command-exit 0`. At base this step throws on `@objectstack/spec` (the card's CI run).
- `bash scripts/create-scaffold-smoke.sh` was **not run locally**. It refuses without `packages/cli/dist`, and it needs a full monorepo build plus registry installs of every template. That does not fit the container's ~10-minute foreground cap on a shared box. The end-to-end proof is this PR's own `os-create-smoke` run, whose path filter names this file.

## Gates (all at `34fff6b49`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` took the change set from git (1 path) and derived 31 commands. All 31 ran and exited 0. `--ran` reconciles them: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 31 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- `pnpm check:publish-smoke-pin` prints `SELF-TEST PASSED (10 cases)`.
- `check-self-test-wired` and `check-self-test-workflow-commands` exit 0, and so do their self-tests.
- `pnpm check:lockstep-package-count` prints `all 3 occurrence(s) agree with the true count (69)`. The docblock count line is untouched.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` prints `1828 cases pass`.
- **ESLint, narrowed to this file, with the three proofs:**
  - `eslint --print-config` puts this file in scope with 2 rules: `no-restricted-imports` and `comment-swallow/no-code-inside-block-comment`.
  - `eslint --no-inline-config --format json scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs` reports 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, as `eslint.config.mjs` states near line 327), and both rules are per-file. This diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
  - Repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

No changeset: root `scripts/` ships in no package's `files[]`. The PR carries the `skip-changeset` label.

## Acceptance notes

- The refusal text changed from "returned non-JSON" to "printed no JSON document ending its stdout". No script or workflow parses it: grep finds zero hits.
- `listPublicPackages` also parses `pnpm -r list --depth -1 --json` whole. pnpm list runs no lifecycle script, and its stdout parsed cleanly in this worktree (81 members, 69 publishable). It is not touched.
- PR #22691 edits this file's docblock count line (69 → 70), which this diff does not touch. Whichever PR lands later merges main. Its red `os-create-smoke` is this defect.
